description: Values and uncertainties for the parameters of interest in the profile likelihood fit to $\overline{m_J}$, $m_{jj}$, and $m_{tj}$ using data. The parameters of interest are the top quark mass, $m_t$, and the ratio of the measured cross-section to the Standard Model expectation of the $t\bar{t}$ cross-section, $\mu$.
location: The uncertainties on $m_t$ in data are quoted in Table 2 of the publication.
name: Post-fit values and uncertainties for parameters of interest
